name: cyber-simple-english
description: Write clear, unambiguous cybersecurity documentation and training content, based on the rules of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one word one meaning, active voice, condition before command, no definitions that a security reader does not need.

interface.shortDescription: Write clear cybersecurity documentation and training material.
interface.longDescription: Load clear-writing rules automatically for cybersecurity documentation, training content, runbooks, and internal incident notes. Built on the writing rules of ASD-STE100.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this runbook in Cyber Simple English.
Write this incident response procedure in Cyber Simple English.
Check this document for Cyber Simple English violations.
